sections.title: 1. Student and application
sections.description: Who is applying, where, and how this project should position them.
sections.descriptionZh: 了解学生背景、申请目标，以及这个项目在申请作品集中的定位。

questions.label: Current major, year or level
questions.labelZh: 当前专业、年级或学习阶段
questions.description: Establishes the student's educational context and the appropriate level of presentation.
questions.descriptionZh: 明确学生的教育背景与经验阶段，以匹配合适的表达深度。

questions.label: Relevant strengths
questions.labelZh: 相关优势
questions.description: Identifies the abilities the portfolio should foreground, such as conceptual thinking, making, coding, research, or storytelling.
questions.descriptionZh: 确定作品集应重点强化的能力，例如概念、制作、编程、研究或叙事。

questions.label: Target degree level and intake year
questions.labelZh: 目标学位（研究生/本科生）与入学年份
questions.description: Sets the application level and year so positioning matches the expected admissions standard.
questions.descriptionZh: 明确申请层级与年份，使作品定位符合相应的录取标准。

questions.label: Target regions, schools, and exact programs
questions.labelZh: 目标地区、学校及准确的专业名称
questions.description: Enables program-specific positioning and current admissions research. Separate confirmed targets from exploratory ones.
questions.descriptionZh: 用于针对具体专业进行定位与最新申请要求研究，并区分已确认和仍在探索的目标。

questions.label: Desired balance of art, design, research, and technology
questions.labelZh: 艺术、设计、研究与技术的期望比重
questions.description: Determines whether the case study reads primarily as artistic inquiry, design, research, technology, or a deliberate mixture.
questions.descriptionZh: 决定项目主要呈现为艺术探索、设计、研究、技术或几者的有意结合。

questions.label: Role of this project in the full portfolio
questions.labelZh: 该项目在完整作品集中的作用
questions.description: Defines whether this project should act as an opener, anchor, technical proof, process study, contrast, or closer.
questions.descriptionZh: 确定该项目在完整申请作品集中的编辑作用。

questions.label: Desired positioning and tone
questions.labelZh: 期望的个人与项目定位：活泼，诗意，反思性等
questions.description: Guides the voice and presentation, such as experimental, poetic, playful, critical, reflective, or technically rigorous.
questions.descriptionZh: 指导项目的文字语气与视觉呈现方式，例如实验性、诗意、活泼、批判性、反思性或技术严谨。

questions.label: Visual references, likes, and styles to avoid
questions.labelZh: 视觉参考、偏好与希望避免的风格
questions.description: Record this project's genre, style references, likes and avoidances. Undecided is acceptable. A preference supplies direction for later proposals; it is not style approval and does not select a previous demo layout.
questions.descriptionZh: 记录本项目的类型、风格参考、偏好与希望避免的风格；尚未决定也可以。偏好用于之后提出方向，不代表已批准风格，也不会自动选用旧演示版式。

sections.title: 2. Project truth
sections.description: Only record work that the student actually made or can honestly label as TBD.
sections.descriptionZh: 只记录学生实际完成的内容，未知事实可诚实标记为待定。

questions.label: Project name or labelled working title
questions.labelZh: 项目名称或已注明的暂定名称
questions.description: Gives the single project a stable name for copy, planning, frame names, and revisions.
questions.descriptionZh: 为文案、方案、Frame 命名和修改建立稳定的单项目名称。

questions.label: Theme, central question, and intended meaning
questions.labelZh: 主题、核心问题与预期含义
questions.description: Defines the conceptual spine: what the project explores and communicates.
questions.descriptionZh: 明确项目探索什么、希望传达什么。

questions.label: Origin, motivation, and context
questions.labelZh: 起源、动机与背景
questions.description: Explains why the project began and why the inquiry matters.
questions.descriptionZh: 说明项目为何开始，以及这项探索为何重要。

questions.label: Intended audience or encounter
questions.labelZh: 预期受众或体验方式
questions.description: Describes who encounters the work and the intended mode of experience.
questions.descriptionZh: 描述谁会体验作品，以及希望产生怎样的体验。

questions.label: Student role and individual contribution
questions.labelZh: 学生角色与个人贡献
questions.description: Makes the student's authorship, decisions, and strongest contribution clear.
questions.descriptionZh: 明确学生本人的创作归属、决策与主要贡献。

questions.label: Timeline, duration, current stage, and completion status
questions.labelZh: 时间线、时长、当前阶段与完成状态
questions.description: Establishes when the work happened, how long it took, and whether it is final or developing.
questions.descriptionZh: 明确项目时间、持续时长和当前完成状态。

questions.label: Medium, materials, and scale
questions.labelZh: 媒介、材料与尺度
questions.description: Describe the work's actual physical or digital form, materials, size, duration or scope. This concerns the work itself, not the dimensions of the portfolio layout.
questions.descriptionZh: 描述作品本身实际的实体或数字形式、材料、尺寸、时长或范围；这里询问作品本身，不是作品集版式的尺寸。

questions.label: Site or platform and mode of presentation
questions.labelZh: 场地或平台与呈现方式
questions.description: Captures where and how the work is experienced.
questions.descriptionZh: 说明作品在哪里以及以何种形式被体验。

questions.label: Process stages and research
questions.labelZh: 调研过程阶段与研究
questions.description: Supplies the chronological or conceptual development and research that informed the work.
questions.descriptionZh: 提供项目的发展阶段以及真正影响作品的调研。

questions.label: Experiments, failures, iterations, and decisions
questions.labelZh: 实验、失败、迭代与决策
questions.description: Shows how the student tested alternatives, responded to problems, and made choices.
questions.descriptionZh: 展示学生如何测试方案、应对问题并作出决定。

questions.label: Final work, viewer experience, and actual or planned outcome
questions.labelZh: 最终作品、观众体验与实际或计划结果
questions.description: State what the final work is, how a viewer encounters or interacts with it, and what actually happened. Separate observed results from intended or still-planned outcomes; describe the current state honestly if the work is unfinished.
questions.descriptionZh: 说明最终作品是什么、观众如何观看或与其互动，以及实际发生了什么。区分已观察到的结果与预期或仍在计划中的结果；如果作品尚未完成，请如实描述当前状态。

questions.label: Reflection, limitations, and possible next direction
questions.labelZh: 反思、局限与下一步方向
questions.description: Provides material for a mature ending: unresolved issues, limitations, learning, and continuation.
questions.descriptionZh: 为结尾提供尚未解决的问题、局限、学习与未来方向。

questions.label: The one idea reviewers should remember
questions.labelZh: 希望评审记住的一个核心观点
questions.description: Establishes the editorial priority that should remain memorable after review.
questions.descriptionZh: 确定评审看完后最应记住的编辑重点。

sections.title: 3. Technology and AI
sections.description: Record technology and AI/ML actually used, including pretrained computer vision. AI is never forced into a project.
sections.descriptionZh: 记录实际使用的技术与 AI/机器学习，包括预训练计算机视觉；不会强行加入 AI。

questions.label: What tools or technologies did you actually use?
questions.labelZh: 你实际使用了哪些工具或技术？
questions.description: Records actual software, code, hardware, fabrication, sensors, data, APIs, or pipelines.
questions.descriptionZh: 记录实际使用的软件、代码、硬件、制作工艺、传感器、数据、API 或流程。

questions.label: Why was the technology necessary to the inquiry?
questions.labelZh: 为什么该技术对项目探究是必要的？
questions.description: Connects technical choices to the artistic inquiry instead of treating technology as decoration.
questions.descriptionZh: 将技术选择与艺术探究联系起来，避免仅把技术作为装饰。

questions.label: Was AI or machine learning used?
questions.labelZh: 是否使用了 AI 或机器学习？
questions.description: Yes includes pretrained computer vision and other machine-learning models, not only generative AI. Choose No only if no AI/ML was used. A confirmed Yes opens the four AI/ML questions; an existing answer is never silently reinterpreted.
questions.descriptionZh: “是”包括预训练计算机视觉及其他机器学习模型，不只指生成式 AI。只有完全没有使用 AI/机器学习时才选“否”。确认“是”后显示四道 AI/机器学习问题；不会默默改变已填写的答案。

questions.label: Models and AI/ML tools actually used
questions.labelZh: 实际使用的模型和 AI/机器学习工具
questions.description: Records actual pretrained, trained or generative model/tool names and relevant versions; keep unknown specifics unresolved rather than guessing.
questions.descriptionZh: 记录实际使用的预训练、自训练或生成式模型/工具名称与相关版本；未知的具体信息保持未确认，不作猜测。

questions.label: What the student authored, selected, prompted, coded, edited, rejected, or curated
questions.labelZh: 学生本人创作、选择、编写提示词、编程、编辑、淘汰或策划了什么
questions.description: Makes the student's creative and technical agency distinct from model output.
questions.descriptionZh: 区分学生本人的创意与技术决策和模型生成内容。

questions.label: What did collaborators, models, or third parties contribute?
questions.labelZh: 合作者、模型或第三方分别贡献了什么？
questions.description: Identifies contributions supplied by people, pretrained models, datasets, APIs, or other systems.
questions.descriptionZh: 说明人员、预训练模型、数据集、API 或其他系统提供了什么。

questions.label: What AI/ML-process material should the portfolio show?
questions.labelZh: 作品集应展示哪些 AI/机器学习过程材料？
questions.description: Identifies comparisons, code, model integration, tests, diagrams, failures, recordings or prompt logs when relevant.
questions.descriptionZh: 确定值得展示的对比、代码、模型整合、测试、图表、失败输出、录像，以及适用时的提示词记录。

sections.title: 4. Delivery and Figma
sections.description: Five combined spreads by default. One count controls both pages and native Figma frames; the target file can wait until conversion.
sections.descriptionZh: 默认五个合并跨页；一个数量同时控制页面与原生 Figma Frame，目标文件可推迟到转换前提供。

questions.label: Combined spread count (4–15; default 5)
questions.labelZh: 合并跨页数量（4–15；默认 5）
questions.description: One combined spread is one page and one 5120 × 1600 native Figma frame (16:5). Keep the default or change it once.
questions.descriptionZh: 一个合并跨页就是一个页面和一个 5120 × 1600 原生 Figma Frame（16:5）。可以保留默认值或一次修改。

questions.label: Figma Design URL or file key
questions.labelZh: Figma Design 链接或文件密钥
questions.description: Optional until Figma conversion. Supply your own target file when you request editable Figma; sharing a source does not approve a new design or write.
questions.descriptionZh: 在 Figma 转换前可暂不填写。需要可编辑 Figma 时提供你自己的目标文件；提供参考源不代表批准新版设计或写入。
